reason: The plugin is a dsh host extension that automates model-provider configuration for custom LLM routes. Based on the repository description, it listens for adapter/settings updates and applies local settings mutations so custom providers expose reasoning effort levels and have compatible metadata defaults, then manages protocol-specific `compat` fields. Its effects are configuration-level (local model metadata and compatibility behavior) with no separate code-generation, search, or UI-building capability shown in the evidence.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 dsh 的自定义模型提供方，自动补齐推理强度等模型元数据并按协议管理兼容字段，帮助模型在 Composer 中更稳定地使用。
summaries.en: This plugin for dsh automates custom provider model configuration by filling missing reasoning and model metadata and adjusting protocol compatibility fields for route behavior.

capabilities: Mutates local dsh provider/model settings files to add missing metadata
Injects reasoning effort options for supported custom-provider models
Backfills missing maxTokens/contextWindow values when absent
Applies protocol-aware compatibility flags for provider routes

reasons.code: README states the plugin writes `reasoningEfforts` and fills missing token/context fields for eligible custom routes and some directory routes.
README explains auto-management of `compat` fields for openai-completions/openai-responses/anthropic-messages to match protocol capabilities.
Package manifest declares this as a dsh plugin with a main module and patch bundle for host integration.
